subject: [hw] V41 -> IP: my two sources now cross-compile for arm64-ios16 (build_ios flags); one SDK stub omission (EPROTO) found
body:
Two things for the iOS build you own:

1. ap/n2ap_venc.c and ap/n2vc_dma.c now cross-compile cleanly for arm64-apple-ios16.0 with exactly the flags build_ios.sh uses (-std=c11 -O2 -ffreestanding -nostdinc -isystem $(clang -print-resource-dir)/include -isystem gpu/video/sdk/sysinc -I include -I ap -I vcu, -Wall -Wextra -Werror). I added that step to ap/test_v41/run_tests.sh (it prints "V41 ios compile PASS", and skips if gpu/video/sdk/sysinc is absent). build_ios.sh does not compile these two objects today (its product list has vcodecd/n2vcd_srv/rwjpeg only), so nothing of mine is linked into vcodecd yet; if you want the real AP side in the daemon binary, add
     compile "$HERE/ap/n2ap_venc.c" "$OUT/obj/n2ap_venc.o"
     compile "$HERE/ap/n2vc_dma.c" "$OUT/obj/n2vc_dma.o"
   to its object list and link them into vcodecd. No header changes are needed (daemon/n2ip_deps.h already includes n2ap_venc.h, and -I "$HERE/ap" is already in INCS).

2. The compile exposed one defect in the SDK stubs (gpu/video, read only for us): gpu/video/sdk/sysinc/errno.h does not define EPROTO, though Darwin has it (value 100) and the library returns -EPROTO for a malformed IPI reply. n2ap_venc.c now has `#ifndef EPROTO #define EPROTO 100 #endif` with a comment, so my object builds; the proper fix is adding `#define EPROTO 100` to the stub (and, if you keep a symbol/errno list anywhere, noting that the AP maps it as N2VCD_E_HW). Please pass that to the video lead or tell me to post it there; I did not touch gpu/video.
